notes_for_editor: Thin record: only two lists name the tower and both give just 'Chapleau'. The Ontario LIO tower dataset (cached at data/raw/ontario_lio/fire_towers.geojson, OBJECTID 590, ident TOW-28533-1) has a Bolkow point at 48.100514, -83.931242, verified and within 10 m, but no height, build date or status; it cannot be footnoted because the geohub dataset page is script-only in our cache. That point lies roughly 50 km north-west of Chapleau town by my rough estimate, so 'Chapleau' may mean the wider area rather than the town. The fan list's original oocities URL now returns 404; the cited copy is the geocities.ws archive. The list's heading is undated. Build, design, staffing and fires are unsourced; the story leaves them out.
